resources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single original decorative emblem asset for the native Android hydroponics app HydroMate, not a screen mockup. Square composition on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Subject: a small botanical seedling with two richly detailed natural green leaves, visible fine veins, tiny dew drops and wet glossy highlights, growing partly through a clear cyan glass water-drop capsule / slightly spherical bubble. No soil or opaque pot. Strong Frutiger Aero / Frutiger Eco early-2000s optimistic ecological technology character. The glass is physically thick, transparent, polished and aquatic with light cyan rim, bright white specular reflections, subtle refraction and a soft contact shadow. Leaves must look organic and photoreal, not geometric or clay. Broad studio light from upper left, moderate front three-quarter perspective, bright fresh lime/leaf greens and aqua, restrained complexity readable at 90 dp. One centered subject occupies 80 percent of square; generous clean transparent margins. No lettering, numbers, text, logos, UI, gauges, water-level marks, status indicators, watermark, checkerboard pixels, background rectangle, matte plastic, cartoon face, purple neon or dark background.
